_comment: Full course titles for the Scene A rail.
Panopto gives the pipeline a course NUMBER and a lecture name and nothing
else, so the title that sits under the course code is looked up here.
One entry per course, filled in once. A lecture's own metadata.json may
carry a course_title key to override this, and --course-title overrides
both. An unknown code is not an error: the rail draws the code and the
lecture line and says so in the log.
Keep titles short enough to wrap onto two 432px lines; the renderer will
shrink and then truncate, and will tell you when it does.
A newline inside a title forces the break there; without one the renderer balances the two lines. 15-210's break is the one in Phillip's proof render.
